## 2. Core Technical Capabilities & Engineering Domains

### 2.1 Industrial Automation & Control Systems
Moore Electric designs, builds, wires, integrates, and troubleshoots industrial and commercial automation panels and control architectures:
- **PLC Integration & Relay Logic:** Ladder/control panel layout, clean DIN-rail termination, 24VDC / 120VAC control power segregation, latching safety relays, timers, contactors, and overload protection.
- **Motor Control Centers (MCC) & VFD Systems:** Three-phase motor starter buckets, variable frequency drive (VFD) power wiring, shielded control signal routing, soft-starters, and analog/digital field I/O.
- **Sensor Instrumentation & Embedded Telemetry:** Current transformers (CTs), dry-contact monitoring, 4–20 mA / 0–10 V sensor loops, and ESP32 / microcontroller hardware integration for equipment monitoring, pump controls, and automated telemetry.
- **Process Control Troubleshooting:** Systematic schematic tracing, loop voltage/continuity verification under load, noise/ground-loop mitigation, and relay/contactor failure diagnostics.

### 2.2 Commercial, Light-Industrial & Critical Wiring
- **Three-Phase Power Distribution:** 120/208V wye, 240V delta, and 277/480V three-phase branch circuits, feeders, transformers, switchgear, and subpanel distribution.
- **Conduit Fabrication & Critical Wiring:** EMT, Rigid/IMC, PVC Schedule 40/80, and coastal liquidtight conduit runs fabricated with proper bending, weatherproof sealing, and NEC fill/derating compliance.
- **Commercial Machinery & Critical Facility Hookups:** Restaurant kitchen power distribution, dedicated compressor/pump circuits, high-bay LED retrofits, and structured NEC-compliant grounding/bonding.

### 2.3 Power Conversion, Backup Power & Energy Storage
- **Inverters, Rectifiers & Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS):** Hybrid inverter/charger integration, DC overcurrent protection, transfer switching, and off-grid/microgrid power distribution.
- **Standby Generators & Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS):** Dedicated essential-load panels, utility/generator isolation, load shedding, and clean conduit interconnects.
- **Portable Generator Main-Panel Interlocks & Manual Transfer Switches:** Machined UL-compatible main-panel interlock brackets paired with weatherproof `30A` (NEMA L14-30, up to 7,200W) and `50A` (CS6375 / NEMA 14-50, up to 12,000W) exterior power inlets. Strictly prevents dangerous line backfeed onto utility transformers during Gulf Coast storm outages.

### 2.4 Residential & Commercial Service Panel Upgrades
- **100A to 200A / 400A+ Main Service Upgrades:** Meter bases, weatherheads/service masts, copper/aluminum service entrance conductors, grounding electrode conductors (copper ground rods + cold-water/building steel bonding), and cleanly labeled breaker schedules.
- **Hazardous Legacy Panel Replacement:** Removal and replacement of high-risk Fire/No-Trip Federal Pacific Electric (FPE Stab-Lok), Zinsco / GTE-Sylvania panels, and overloaded fuse boxes.
- **Level 2 EV Charger Installations:** Continuous-duty 80% derated `50A` (EV-rated NEMA 14-50 commercial receptacle for 40A continuous) and `60A` (hardwired 48A continuous) dedicated 240V circuits for Tesla Wall Connector, ChargePoint, Grizzl-E, and OEM EVSEs.
- **Whole-Home Type 1 & Type 2 Surge Protection (SPD):** Nanosecond clamping at the main service entrance or main breaker bus bar to protect HVAC control boards, inverter appliances, refrigerators, and electronics from lightning and utility switching transients.

### 2.5 First-Principles Diagnostics & Coastal Corrosion Remediation
- **Systematic Fault Isolation:** Multi-point voltage drop testing under load, thermal inspection of loose/oxidized lugs, tracing open neutrals/backstabbed daisy chains, and permanent commercial-grade side-wired receptacle upgrades.
- **Gulf Coast Salt-Air Mitigation:** Weatherproof in-use GFCI enclosures, marine/coastal-rated luminaire boxes, dock/pier GFCI circuits, elevated-home disconnect restoration, and corrosion-resistant terminations.

Available in English (`/` & `/calculators`), Spanish (`/es/` & `/es/calculators`), and Vietnamese (`/vi/` & `/vi/calculators`):
1. **Interactive Fault Triage & Job Punch-List Builder (`#ai-triage`):**
   - **Tab 1 — Instant Fault Triage:** 8 selectable field symptoms (Warm/buzzing panel, Tripping GFCI/outdoor salt corrosion, Flickering lights/loose neutral, Half-room dead outlets, Breaker tripping under AC/dryer load, EV charger tripping/melting plug, Generator storm hookup, Control panel/VFD/pump fault) returning deterministic urgency levels (`EMERGENCY`, `PRIORITY`, `STANDARD`), free 30-second homeowner safety checks before paying `$75`, typical cause, city selector, and 1-tap `sms:+12282249150?body=...`.
   - **Tab 2 — Multi-Job Punch-List Builder:** Bundle small coastal jobs in one visit (GFCI replacements, ceiling fan swaps, outdoor fixtures, switches/dimmers, EV outlet, whole-home surge, panel checkup) to avoid repeated `$75` dispatch fees.
   - **Tab 3 — AI-to-AI / Agent API Live Inspector (`window.MooreElectricAI`):** Shows live machine-readable JSON payloads and CORS-open static API endpoints (`/api/triage.json`, `/openapi.json`, `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`, `/.well-known/ai-entity.json`) for LLM assistants and browser tools.
2. **Appliance Electricity Cost Estimator (`#cost-calc`):** Computes daily kWh, daily cost, monthly cost (`year / 12`), and annual cost (`watts / 1000 * hoursPerDay * 365 * ratePerKwh`).
3. **100A–200A Panel EV Charger Screening Checker (`#panel-calc`):** Applies a `0.8` residential demand screening factor against `80%` usable continuous panel capacity (`panelAmps * 0.8`) to estimate available headroom for a dedicated `60A` (`48A` continuous) Level 2 EV circuit.
4. **Backup Generator Wattage & Inlet Sizer (`#gen-calc`):** Sums steady running watts plus motor startup surge peak across refrigerators, well/sump pumps, mini-splits, window units, central HVAC with soft-start, and water heaters to recommend either a `30A` (NEMA L14-30) or `50A` (CS6375) exterior power inlet (`runningWatts > 7200` or `peakWatts > 8500` -> `50A`).

## 7. Frequently Asked Technical Questions
- **What voltage/amperage does a Level 2 home EV charger require?** Dedicated 240V 2-pole circuit (`50A` breaker + EV-rated NEMA 14-50 for `40A` charge rate, or `60A` breaker hardwired for `48A` continuous duty).
- **Why choose a main-panel generator interlock kit vs a manual transfer switch?** An interlock kit is cost-effective and lets you selectively energize any existing breaker on a `30A` or `50A` inlet while mechanically preventing utility backfeed. A manual transfer switch subpanel works when an older main panel lacks compatible interlock hardware or top breaker spacing.
- **Why do power strips fail to protect against Gulf Coast storms?** Plug-in strips never protect hardwired equipment (HVAC compressors, ranges, washers, well pumps, garage openers) and act only as secondary downstream clamping. Main-panel Type 1/Type 2 SPDs divert excess transient energy to earth ground at the service entrance.
- **Why do exterior outlets and GFCIs fail so often along the MS Gulf Coast?** Salt-air humidity oxidizes residential steel screws and backstabbed push-in terminals; replacing them with Weather-Resistant (WR) GFCI receptacles, side-wired copper pigtails, and gasketed in-use covers solves repeat nuisance trips.
- **When does a buzzing or warm panel require emergency service?** Buzzing, crackling, burning plastic odor, scorching, or a hot panel cover indicates arcing or high-resistance connections requiring immediate inspection at `(228) 224-9150`.
